records.name: Young Artist Program (YAP)
records.summary: A no-cost arts program that explores social justice through art-making for young people ages 14 to 25 in Philadelphia. It is aimed at BIPOC LGBTQ+ youth and allies.
records.what_you_do: Apply through the form on the site, then join weekly studio sessions to make art with other young people.

schedule.text: Weekly sessions Wednesday to Friday, 4:00 to 6:30 pm. The summer schedule runs June to August. Open events for all ages are listed without dates.

locations.label: Studio in the Northern Liberties area (address not listed)

cost.text: Free. Donations and a supply wishlist are optional.

first_step.how: Apply through the Google form linked on the site. Applications are taken year-round.
first_step.basis: Year-round applications for a free program, through a public form.

records.notes: The footer reads 2021 and the summer schedule is only in images, so the page may be out of date. No email or phone is listed. The site says the program serves BIPOC LGBTQ+ people and allies; the vocabulary has no BIPOC tag, so only lgbtq is tagged.

records.name: The Thread
records.summary: A free art installation in Vernon Park in Germantown. Visitors can use an old rotary phone to leave a voicemail about grief, healing or someone they have lost, and recordings may be kept in a project archive.
records.what_you_do: Visit the phone in Vernon Park, or call the story line to leave a voicemail. You can also sign up for news.

schedule.text: Open daily, with no set hours listed.

cost.text: Free and open daily.

first_step.how: Visit the installation, or call the story line to leave a voicemail.
first_step.basis: Free and open to anyone, with a simple phone route to take part.

records.notes: The site says The Thread is not a helpline and links to a Resources page for support, which was not read. The Events page URL was inferred from a relative link and not opened. Rail Park is mentioned without details.

records.name: The Fourth Grade Project
records.summary: An art project built from interviews with fourth graders, now offered as free online lesson plans for teachers.
records.notes: No in-person classes, events, volunteer roles or membership for a Philadelphia resident. Lesson plans and donations only.

records.name: History Making Productions
records.summary: A film and education media producer focused on Philadelphia history.
records.notes: The site lists no programs, events, workshops, volunteer roles or membership. Two different contact emails appear on the page, so none is recorded.

records.name: New Door Books
records.summary: A literary publisher that releases fiction, run as a project of a long-running writers group.
records.notes: A publisher with no public program on the about page. The Working Writers Group is listed in leads_only.

records.name: The Raymond Farm Center for Living Arts & Design
records.summary: An arts and design center in New Hope, Bucks County, that runs workshops, farm tours and lectures about the Raymonds' house and farm.
records.notes: Located in New Hope, Bucks County, not in Philadelphia. The featured list on the directory names a 'Raymond Center' that is probably this group, so check for duplicates.

records.name: Sine Timore Theatre Company
records.summary: A nonprofit theatre company that runs youth and adult camps, productions and private lessons from a rehearsal studio in Abington.
records.notes: The rehearsal studio is in Abington, Montgomery County, outside Philadelphia city limits. It could be reconsidered if suburban groups are in scope for the directory.

records.name: Warrior Writers
records.summary: A national nonprofit that helps veterans write and make art about their experiences, with workshops in other cities and online.
records.notes: The site lists no Philadelphia program. Its only Philadelphia link is a past project with refugees and local veterans. Visitors can email the group to ask about options near them.

notes: Start point: culturetrust.org returned an empty page on both fetches, so the project list was read from the CultureWorks directory (cultureworksphila.org, fiscal-sponsorship/fiscally-sponsored-projects, 86 entries). CultureWorks Greater Philadelphia runs the CultureTrust program, and sources give different project counts (80 vs 90 plus). Budget: all 60 fetches and 1 of 4 searches used, so 22 linked sites were not read and are in leads_only. Results: 36 publish, 3 hide (out_of_scope), 3 out_of_area, and 8 checked groups dropped without a record: CommonSoul Communications (contact only, no dated activity), ENA Ensemble (no way in, no dated activity), iMPeRFeCT Gallery (exhibitions only, no address or hours), Journey On Education (no way in on the home page), LGBTQ+ Editors Association (no Philadelphia presence shown), Practice Space Collective (no offerings visible), Run Boy Run Productions (last dated item 2017, no way in), and Theater of Witness (screenings by email only). Three entries are broken or unreachable (see blocked). Eight entries are social-only and two have no link (see leads_only and below). Featured names with no link: Glass Commons, Philly Drum Project, Future of Food Philadelphia, and Raymond Center (probably the Raymond Farm Center record, a duplicate). Many sponsored projects list 1315 Walnut St (Suite 300 or 320), which is the sponsor's office; these are not recorded as meeting places. Kept published for reviewer decision: NEPCA (status dormant, newest dated item July 2022). Low confidence: Actívate Stories, Casa de Duende, GameOn!, Keeping Society, Onyx Valley, Past Present Projects, Operation Save Our City, Our Market Project, Get Fresh Daily, and Young Artist Program (footer dated 2021). Philly Bluegrass's Center City jam RSVP email is a host's personal address and was not recorded; its Doylestown and Perkasie jams are outside the city. The Thread's site says it is not a helpline. GameOn!'s email is obscured and not recorded. Redirects followed: activate-media.org to activatestories.org, and the Run Boy Run wix page to runboyrunproductions.com. Paddle type for RiverWays is not stated; kayaking is the closest tag.
